name: Bronte Callaghan
bio:
Bronte's motorsport journey began with a childhood fascination for Formula One, staying up late to watch races broadcast from Europe. Despite a lack of family connections in the industry, she pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics and data analysis. After graduating, she gained experience analyzing performance data in a small racing team, before deciding to specialise as a strategist.

Bronte is driven by a desire to optimise every aspect of race strategy. She meticulously analyzes historical data, weather patterns, and competitor performance to develop optimal strategies. While entry-level, Bronte is a quick learner and always eager to improve.

What sets Bronte apart is her attention to detail and her ability to think creatively under pressure. She is not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and is always looking for innovative ways to gain a competitive edge, even if it means suggesting a bold move at a crucial moment.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy, often tied back in a practical ponytail during race events.
physical.description: Bronte has a focused and determined expression, with a practical no-nonsense air about her.

quirks: Always carries a lucky echidna figurine.
Meticulously colour-codes all her strategy notes.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
